lines.en: But once I realize where that is, I have a hard time freeing myself from her grasp.
lines.zh: 但当我意识到那是哪里之后,我很难从她的掌握中脱身。

lines.en: : Uhh...on second thought, I should probably leave. I don’t really like showing my face around here.
lines.zh: : 呃……再一想,我可能该走了。我不太喜欢在这一带露脸。

lines.en: : Oh yeah. You had a thing with karaoke booths, right? So much that you took me to a fuckin’ love hotel instead of one.
lines.zh: : 哦对。你和卡拉 OK 包间有过节,对吧?过节到你都宁愿带我去他妈的情趣酒店,也不去包间。
: 情趣酒店?!

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ happened. Just a bad night. But hey, I’m still on whatever team gets this guy the fuck outta here, so I won’t complain if he doesn’t wanna join us.
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生。就是糟糕的一晚。不过嘿,只要能让这家伙他妈的离开这儿,我站哪队都行,所以他不想加入我们我也不抱怨。

lines.en: : Douchefriend, is it because you are afraid of melodically rhythm-talking? Because you should not be! We will not judge you for the shape of your voice!
lines.zh: : 人渣朋友,是因为你害怕带旋律地节奏说话吗?你不该怕!我们不会因为你声音的形状评判你!

lines.en: : The Nao-chan is right! We must all sing!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱说得对!我们所有人都必须唱!

lines.en: : Wait, must? Fuck that. I ain’t singing shit. I’m here for the food.
lines.zh: : 等等,必须?去他的。我他妈什么都不唱。我是来吃东西的。

lines.en: : We will sing a song together! After the food happens! It is a promise!
lines.zh: : 我们会一起唱一首歌!在吃完东西之后!这是约定!
: 呃,不,这不是约定?
: 我真的不想——

lines.en: Resistance winds up being futile as Nao drags me past my aversion to karaoke booths and the two girls I’m more comfortable with leave to go get food.
lines.zh: 抵抗终究徒劳,Nao 把我拖过了我对卡拉 OK 包间的抗拒,而那两个让我更自在的女孩则离开去拿食物了。

lines.en: I can only imagine how well this night is going to go.
lines.zh: 我只能想象,今晚会有多顺利。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to go with them and maybe leave me alone here for a few minutes? Preferably handcuffed to the table or something?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想跟她们去,顺便让我在这里独自待几分钟?最好用手铐铐在桌子上什么的?

lines.en: : I just don’t have a good track record in this place, okay? Either the world explodes or I almost assault someone. And you’re in prime position to be assaulted, Nao.
lines.zh: : 我只是在这个地方的前科不太好看,行吗?要么世界爆炸,要么我差点侵犯谁。而你现在正处于被侵犯的绝佳位置,Nao。

lines.en: : And of course you don’t care. Because you can probably slice me in half with your not-so-secret mind-powers if I get too close.
lines.zh: : 而你当然不在乎。因为要是我靠太近,你八成能用你那不算秘密的精神力量把我切成两半。

lines.en: : Or just send me to McDonalds again where we can ignore the horrible things that happen in here next.
lines.zh: : 或者再把我送去麦当劳,这样我们就能无视接下来在这里发生的恐怖事情。

lines.en: : What? What are you silently exclaiming about over there?
lines.zh: : 什么?你在那边无声地惊叹什么?

lines.en: Nao ignores the bright, flashing Karaoke splash screen in favor of...
lines.zh: Nao 无视了明亮闪烁的卡拉 OK 启动画面,转而选中了……

lines.en: She shakes them three times, causing me to subconsciously make a wish. But instead of wishing for her safety, I accidentally wind up wishing to find out how her frog got here.
lines.zh: 她摇了三下,害我下意识许了个愿。但我没有许愿她平安,而是一不小心许愿想知道她的青蛙是怎么到这儿来的。

lines.en: It’s all for nothing as I still don’t know, though. But what I do know is if I snatch those maracas out of her hand and bash her over the head with them, I can probably make a run for it and get away.
lines.zh: 不过全是徒劳,我还是不知道。但我知道的是:要是我把沙锤从她手里抢过来砸她后脑勺,大概能趁机逃跑脱身。

lines.en: : Did you hear that? Or does my face just say “violence” now?
lines.zh: : 你听见什么了吗?还是说我这张脸现在就写着「暴力」?

lines.en: : What? What do you want? Because there’s paper in here and I really hope you’re in the habit of just carrying a pen with you.
lines.zh: : 怎么?你想要什么?这里倒是有纸,而我真心希望你有随身带笔的习惯。

lines.en: : You don’t want me to sing, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不想让我唱,对吧?

lines.en: : Because singing makes me uncomfortable — which may or may not be something that potentially offends you as a mute? I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 因为唱歌让我不自在——而这会不会潜在的冒犯到身为哑者的你?我不太确定。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but no amount of pouting is going to change that. I’m just going to awkwardly stand here until something goes terribly wrong.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,但撅再多嘴也改变不了这一点。我就尴尬地站在这里,直到有什么可怕的事情发生为止。

lines.en: : I have no idea whatever it is I just agreed to, but seeing as you’re now moving closer to the screen, I can only imagine that you are going to try singing. Which I’m sure will work out just great.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道自己刚答应了什么,但既然你正在朝屏幕靠近,我只能想象你打算试着唱歌。我确信那会顺利得不得了。

lines.en: : Can you at least wait for Kaori or Yumi to come back first? If you start magically being able to vocalize all of a sudden, I need someone else to witness it so no one thinks I’m crazy.
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少先等 Kaori 或 Yumi 回来?你要是突然魔法般地能发声了,我得有别人在场见证,免得大家以为我疯了。

lines.en: : What? Are they here? I don’t know what you’re pointing-
lines.zh: : 什么?她们回来了?我不知道你在指什——

lines.en: : There’s nothing there. Unless...you’re telling me to leave?
lines.zh: : 那里什么都没有。除非……你是在叫我走?
: 不是?那是什么——

lines.en: : I AM GONE AND YOU CAN’T SEE ME. HAHAHAHAHAHA!
lines.zh: : 我消失了,你看不见我。哈哈哈哈哈哈!
: 唱吧,Nao 酱!唱!
: (吸气)
: (呼气)

lines.en: : It appears that we’ve gotten ourselves into another sticky situation this time, Nao-chan. However will we escape this peculiar realm?
lines.zh: : 看来,这一次我们又让自己陷入了棘手的处境,Nao 酱。我们究竟要如何逃离这个奇异的领域呢?

lines.en: : If you’re feeling scared, you can hold my hand. Just don’t ask me where it’s been as I can’t quite recall.
lines.zh: : 如果你害怕,可以牵我的手。只是别问我这只手摸过哪里,我记不太清了。

lines.en: : Our first order of business should be mapping out our surroundings in an effort to discern what jurisdiction we have found ourselves in. I’ve been playing Geoguesser lately. I can be trusted.
lines.zh: : 我们的头号要务,应该是勘察四周,弄清我们落在了哪个辖区。我最近一直在玩 Geoguesser。我可以被信任。
: 什么?
: Nao?可我们刚才不是还——

lines.en: : I...can understand you in here. But how? Where even are we?
lines.zh: : 我……在这里能听懂你了。但为什么?我们到底在哪?

lines.en: : Yeah...I can smell the ocean too. But I don’t think that alone is going to be of much help when this is pretty clearly not the world we come from.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也闻到了海的气味。但我觉得,单凭这个帮不上什么忙,毕竟这里显然不是我们来自的那个世界。

lines.en: : Can’t you just send us back again? Like you did in the Old District?
lines.zh: : 你就不能像在旧城区那样,再把我们送回去吗?

lines.en: : What do you mean you don’t know how you did it? Just...think of food again. Maybe that’s what triggered it last time?
lines.zh: : 你说你不知道自己当时怎么做到的,是什么意思?就……再想想食物。也许上次就是那个触发的?

lines.en: : Well...I doubt it’s a reset since you’re here. So maybe we’ll just both snap out of it in a few minutes and-
lines.zh: : 嗯……既然你在这里,我怀疑这不是重置。所以也许过几分钟我们俩都会醒过来,然后——
我被发现了。

lines.en: : Welcome to the Oceanic Branch Office — thank you for patiently waiting, Arjuna Harish. The time has come for your recoordination. A representative will be with you shortly.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到海洋分部办公室——感谢您耐心等待,Arjuna Harish。您的重新协调时刻已经到来。一位代表将很快为您服务。

lines.en: : I...might know where we are? I can...vaguely recall waiting for something.
lines.zh: : 我……大概知道我们在哪了?我能……隐约记起在等待什么。

lines.en: : But in this world, we are all waiting for something. And the struggles that I endure pale in comparison to that of the incomplete b-
lines.zh: : 但在这个世界里,我们都在等待什么。我所承受的挣扎,与那只未完成之蝶相比,不值一提——

lines.en: : Thank you. You might need to do that a few more times if I keep slipping in and out of consciousness. It’s like I’m trying to dream, but I can’t.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。要是我继续时昏时醒,你可能还得再来几次。就像我想做梦,却做不成。

lines.en: : Yes. Thank you for not judging me in this apparent “judgement free zone.”
lines.zh: : 是。谢谢你在这个显而易见的「无评判区」里不评判我。

lines.en: : Please keep conversation to a minimum as someone is currently saying goodbye to a loved one in the next room over.
lines.zh: : 请尽量压低交谈音量,因为隔壁房间正有人在和心爱之人告别。

lines.en: : Fortunately, goodbyes are only temporary now. And HimawariCo. can assure you that your family is always just a click away.
lines.zh: : 所幸,如今告别都只是暂时的。HimawariCo. 可以向您保证,您的家人永远只差一次点击。

lines.en: : I don’t know...I’ve never heard that name before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我从没听过那个名字。
: 哇,行吧。

lines.en: : No, I don’t hear anything...Where? From below us, maybe? Try taking a look over the edge. Maybe there’s-
lines.zh: : 不,我什么都没听见……哪里?也许在我们下面?试着往边沿外看看。也许那里有——

lines.en: : I wouldn’t do that if I were you.
lines.zh: : 我是你就不会那么做。

lines.en: : It gets cold down there this time of year.
lines.zh: : 一年中的这个时候,下面可是很冷的。

lines.en: : It’s a pleasure to finally meet you, Arjuna Harish.
lines.zh: : 终于见到您,真是荣幸,Arjuna Harish。

lines.en: : My name is Amber, and I am the God of Reconstruction. I’ve been chosen to speak to you today based on a series of aptitude tests you’ve filed over the last three decades.
lines.zh: : 我名叫 Amber,是重构之神。我今天被选中与您对话,依据的是您过去三十年间提交的一系列资质测试。

lines.en: : I would now like to explain what it is I hope to offer you in exchange for your unwavering loyalty. It all begins with-
lines.zh: : 我现在想说明,我希望能以什么换取您坚定不移的忠诚。一切始于——

lines.en: : Yeah, no. My name isn’t Arjuna Harish — it’s Akira Arakawa. And I’m not looking for a god. Just a way out.
lines.zh: : 呃,不。我的名字不是 Arjuna Harish——是 Akira Arakawa。我也不是在找神。我只是在找出路。
: Akira Arakawa?
: 对,还有 Nao 酱。

lines.en: : Everyone needs a god, Akira Arakawa. Otherwise, death is accompanied by nothing but nothingness. And I don’t mean the fun kind of nothingness.
lines.zh: : 每个人都需要一位神明,Akira Arakawa。否则,死亡所伴随的将唯有虚无。而我说可不是有趣的那种虚无。

lines.en: : Yeah, what exactly is the “fun” kind of nothingness?
lines.zh: : 是啊,「有趣」的那种虚无到底是什么?

lines.en: : That which rides in on the wings of anhedonia — those moments where you spend too long staring at the wall and recalling when things used to be enjoyable.
lines.zh: : 那是乘着快感缺失之翼而来的东西——那些时刻:你对着一面墙凝望太久,回想着事物曾经有趣的光景。

lines.en: : That’s the fun kind of nothingness?
lines.zh: : 那就是有趣的那种虚无?

lines.en: : Yes, because that nothingness is somethingness. And if it was truly nothing, even thinking would be impossible. It’s the cruelest fate of all.
lines.zh: : 是,因为那种虚无其实是「有」。而如果它真正是什么都没有,连思考都将不可能。那是一切命运中最残忍的。

lines.en: : Okay. Then, what can you offer in place of that?
lines.zh: : 好。那你能用什么取而代之?

lines.en: : For you — nothing. And not the fun kind, but more fun than the not-fun kind.
lines.zh: : 对你——无。不是有趣的那种,但比无趣的那种多一点趣味。

lines.en: : Our ideals are not compatible with one another. But I am interested in this creature you call “Nao-chan.”
lines.zh: : 我们的理念并不相容。但我对你称为「Nao 酱」的这个生物很感兴趣。
: 她是人类,对吧?
: 呃……大概?
: 她说是。

lines.en: : She is here with us? Right now?
lines.zh: : 她和我们一起在这里?现在?

lines.en: : What, can you not see her?
lines.zh: : 怎么,你看不见她?

lines.en: : Describe her to me. These eyes do not see the same thing others do.
lines.zh: : 向我描述她。这双眼睛看见的,和别人不一样。
: 呃……个子小。小麦色。黑发。异色瞳。
: 她穿着衣服?

lines.en: : Maroon-ish hoodie with some hanzi on it. Shorts. Sneakers.
lines.zh: : 栗色连帽衫,上面印着些汉字。短裤。运动鞋。

lines.en: : Underwear? What is she wearing beneath her clothes?
lines.zh: : 内衣?她衣服底下穿的什么?

lines.en: : Sorry, she doesn’t want me to answer that one.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,那一条她不许我回答。

lines.en: : That is fine. I can see her clearer now — and she seems like the exact type of “human” who could benefit from my aid the most.
lines.zh: : 无妨。我现在看清她了——而她似乎是那种最能从我协助中受益的「人类」。

lines.en: : Are you really going to make me translate this entire conversation for you? Amber, do you have a notebook or something?
lines.zh: : 你真打算让我为你翻译整场对话?Amber,你有笔记本之类的吗?

lines.en: : I can give her speech if that is what she wants. A more corporeal form as well. All she’d need to do is survive the cocoon.
lines.zh: : 如果那是她想要的,我可以给她言语。也可以给她更具体的形体。她所需的,只是在茧中活下来。

lines.en: : And what exactly is this “cocoon?” you speak of?
lines.zh: : 你说的这个「茧」,到底是什么?

lines.en: : One naturally unspun, yet deliciously artificial — that uses the offspring of my Wig of Expanse to blanket a creature and inflict metamorphosis.
lines.zh: : 一枚天然不纺、却美味地人工的茧——以我「浩瀚假发」的后代包裹一个生物,施予蜕变。

lines.en: : If you wish to be a better you, it’s the easiest method there is. You merely go to sleep and wake up better. Complete, if you will.
lines.zh: : 如果你想成为更好的自己,这是最简单的方法。你只需睡去,再以更好的姿态醒来。可以说,是圆满。

lines.en: : I’m very popular with influencers these days. They’ll believe in anything so long as it makes them beautiful by someone else’s standards.
lines.zh: : 我近来在网红圈子里非常受欢迎。只要能让他们按别人的标准变美,他们什么都信。

lines.en: : What do you want with Nao-chan then? She’s already perfect. And let it be known that these are her words, not mine.
lines.zh: : 那你想对 Nao 酱做什么?她已经完美了。而且声明在先:这是她写的,不是我说的。

lines.en: : The open wound on my forehead bleeds eternally — carved by the hands of the unseen. I would like her to add a third strike to it.
lines.zh: : 我额头上那道敞开的伤口永世流血——是无形之手所刻。我希望她为它添上第三道刻痕。

lines.en: : There is great promise in those who avoid my eyes. And as I cannot wrap myself in my own cocoon, I rely on these creatures to become more beautiful.
lines.zh: : 那些避开我目光的存在,大有前途。而既然我无法把自己裹进自己的茧,我只能依赖这些生物,来变得更美。

lines.en: : You hurt yourself to become more beautiful?
lines.zh: : 你伤害自己,来变得更美?

lines.en: : There is a great deal of work left to be done...and while the pain is everlasting, I will live under the knife so long as it means that I will one day appear “human.”
lines.zh: : 还有大量工作有待完成……而痛苦固然永续,只要它意味着我有朝一日能显得「像人类」,我便甘愿活在刀下。

lines.en: : Your kind has always fascinated me, Akira Arakawa — the way they persist. Their infinite curiosity. Breasts.
lines.zh: : 你们这一族总是令我着迷,Akira Arakawa——他们坚持的方式。他们无限的求知欲。乳房。

lines.en: : Those are pretty great, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 那玩意确实挺棒的,是吧?
: 抱歉,Nao。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : Will she believe in me? Earn a voice and carve her name upon this body?
lines.zh: : 她会信奉我吗?赢得言语,并在这具身体上刻下她的名字?

lines.en: : She wants to know if there’s a catch. She’s having a hard time believing you’d give her something so big in exchange for a little knife-work.
lines.zh: : 她想知道有没有圈套。她很难相信,你会用这么大的东西,去换一点小小的刀工。

lines.en: : Her period will always come a week early and she’ll no longer be able to taste oranges.
lines.zh: : 她的月经将永远提前一周到来,而且她将再也尝不出橙子的味道。

lines.en: : Also, cellular reception around her will not be able to penetrate the cocoon — which she must remain in for a total of nine years. She will still appear normally to others during this time.
lines.zh: : 另外,她周围的手机信号将无法穿透那只茧——而她必须在茧中待满整整九年。在此期间,她在他人眼中依然如常。

lines.en: : She’s going to say no for now, but I think it’s mostly because of the orange thing? She doesn’t have a cell phone and I’m pretty sure she hasn’t gotten her period yet.
lines.zh: : 她眼下会拒绝,但我想八成是因为橙子那件事?她没有手机,而且我很确定她月经还没来过。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but if you can’t tell her, I have to.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,但你要是不能告诉她,那就得我来。

lines.en: : How unfortunate...as I assume we’ll never meet again. It isn’t often for the same god to appear twice with how many of us there are now.
lines.zh: : 多么遗憾……我猜我们不会再见了。如今我们数量如此庞大,同一位神明出现两次,可不是常事。

lines.en: : I will continue to wait for Arjuna Harish then. Do you know if he will be here soon?
lines.zh: : 那么,我会继续等待 Arjuna Harish。你知道他会不会快到了吗?

lines.en: : No clue, to be honest. But something tells me probably not if I’m here in place of him.
lines.zh: : 老实说,毫无头绪。但既然我是代替他来的,某种直觉告诉我多半不会。

lines.en: : What a terrible day. I may have to ask for a transfer soon.
lines.zh: : 多么糟糕的一天。我也许得申请调岗了。

lines.en: : To where? And who will you even ask? Aren’t you a god?
lines.zh: : 调去哪?而且你能去问谁?你不是神吗?

lines.en: : Yes — but there is one of us for every thought that has ever been thunk. It only makes sense that we’d begin to unionize after a while.
lines.zh: : 是——但每一个被想过的念头,都有我们中的一员。过一阵子我们开始组建工会,合情合理。

lines.en: : Right, okay. Well, I’m ready to wake up and go home now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。嗯,我准备好醒来回家了。

lines.en: : You won’t speak to another in my place after coming all this way? My sister, Lindsey, is the God of Line-Skipping. I am sure she would appreciate you more than I do.
lines.zh: : 你都跑这么远了,不肯代我与其他人对话吗?我的妹妹 Lindsey,是插队之神。我确信她会比我更欣赏你。

lines.en: : Can you send us back now, Nao? Or at least...try to? Because I doubt anyone here will do it when they’re all trying to scout us.
lines.zh: : 你现在能送我们回去吗,Nao?或者至少……试试?因为这里所有人都在物色我们,我不信有谁会送。
: 什么?你看见什么——

lines.en: : It’s that same rat as before — rotund and throbbing. Thinking it’s better than us.
lines.zh: : 是之前那只老鼠——圆滚滚,扑扑跳。还觉得自己比我们高贵。

lines.en: : Do you think it can speak our language? Shape out our letters if we provide it with cheese and other things rats enjoy?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它能说我们的语言吗?如果我们提供奶酪和其他老鼠喜欢的东西,它能拼出我们的字母吗?

lines.en: : I suppose that even that is easier to believe than a false cocoon.
lines.zh: : 我想,就连那个,都比一只虚假的茧更容易让人相信。

lines.en: : The fuck is up with you two? Why you all close and shit? We were only gone for five minutes.
lines.zh: : 你们俩搞什么鬼?怎么贴这么近?我们才离开五分钟。

lines.en: : That’s thirty-five minutes in dog time. We should have been more considerate of their potentially canine feelings.
lines.zh: : 按狗的时间算是三十五分钟。我们本该更体谅他们潜在的犬类感受。

lines.en: : Just to make sure, you remember that too. Right?
lines.zh: : 确认一下,那个你也记得。对吧?
: 好。酷。
: 现在干什么?

lines.en: : Now, we sing! I must search for the songs of the cotton candy girl and repair their words so more animals are involved!
lines.zh: : 现在,我们唱歌!我必须寻找棉花糖女孩的歌,修复它们的词句,好让更多动物参与进来!

lines.en: : Hah...Food’ll be here in twenty minutes, they said. Some bitch named Amber or something fuckin’ ordered the whole ass menu ahead of us.
lines.zh: : 哈……他们说食物二十分钟后到。一个叫 Amber 什么的贱人他妈的抢先我们点了整份菜单。
今晚,我又遇见了一位神明。

lines.en: I don’t think she liked me very much.
lines.zh: 我并不觉得她有多喜欢我。
Nao 酱的好感度提升到了 [nao_love]!
